title: How to Study and Improve
description: Practical advice for getting better: solve tactics daily, analyze your own games, learn essential endgames, and study master games. A roadmap to real progress.

sections.title: Tactics and Endgames First
sections.content: The fastest way to gain rating is daily tactics practice — pattern recognition wins games at every level. Pair this with the essential endgames (king and pawn, basic rook endings) which decide a huge share of games.

positions.commentary: Studying simple winning techniques like rook endgames pays off in real games. Endgame knowledge converts small advantages into full points.

sections.title: Analyze Your Own Games
sections.content: The single most valuable study habit is reviewing your own games — especially losses. Find the moment things went wrong, understand why, and you will stop repeating the same mistakes. Studying annotated master games builds positional understanding over time.

positions.commentary: Improvement is a cycle: play, analyze, learn, repeat. Review your games honestly, study masters, and practice consistently to climb steadily.

exercises.title: Use Your Rook
exercises.description: White to play. Demonstrate basic rook activity by seizing the open file with an aggressive rook move.
